The mount must be connected and unparked (unpark_mount). Moves the telescope: make sure the user expects it. If guiding is active, stop_guiding first (the guide star is lost during the slew). ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status

tools.name: slew_mount
tools.description: Slews the mount to J2000 coordinates (plain goto: no plate solving or centering; add_target with slew_and_center does that in a sequence). The mount must be connected and unparked (unpark_mount). Moves the telescope: make sure the user expects it. If guiding is active, stop_guiding first (the guide star is lost during the slew). Runs as a background job holding the mount; refused while a capture, autofocus or guiding start job runs. Stop it with cancel_job or stop_all. Afterwards check the position with get_status.

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

The mount must be connected and unparked (unpark_mount). Moves the telescope: make sure the user expects it. If guiding is active, stop_guiding first (the guide star is lost during the slew). ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move, filter change or mount job (slew, park, home) runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move, filter change or mount job (slew, park, home) runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move, filter change or mount job (slew, park, home) runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

Needs a connected camera and focuser and stars in the field (the mount should track a star field). Takes one to several minutes, so it usually returns a running job: poll get_job. outcome.data holds the final position, HFR, filter and temperature. The job holds the 'camera' resource (autofocus uses camera and focuser) and is refused while a focuser or mount job runs.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

name.description: Filter name, e.g. "Ha". Mutually exclusive with position.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

Switching power can cut off devices (camera, mount): confirm with the user first. Runs as a background job holding the switch device.

index.description: Zero-based switch index as listed in get_status.

value.description: New value within the switch's min..max (0/1 for on/off switches).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

Returns { job: { id, kind, description, resource, state (running | succeeded | failed | cancelled | abandoned), cancelRequested, startedAt, finishedAt, outcome: { success, message, data } } }. Set wait_seconds to long-poll: the call returns as soon as the job finishes or the wait elapses. Finished jobs are kept for one hour.

job_id.description: Job id as returned by the tool that started it, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish before returning (0-55, default 0 = return immediately).

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

tools.name: cancel_job

Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

The mount must be connected and unparked (unpark_mount). Moves the telescope: make sure the user expects it. If guiding is active, stop_guiding first (the guide star is lost during the slew). Runs as a background job holding the mount; refused while a capture, autofocus or guiding start job runs. Stop it with cancel_job or stop_all. Afterwards check the position with get_status.

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move, filter change or mount job (slew, park, home) runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

Runs as a background job holding the focuser; refused while a camera job (capture or autofocus) runs, because moving focus would spoil it. Prefer run_autofocus for finding focus; use this to return to a known good position.

position.description: Absolute target position in focuser steps (>= 0).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

NINA applies the profile's focus offsets for the filter. Runs as a background job holding the filter wheel; refused while a camera job runs.

name.description: Filter name, e.g. "Ha". Mutually exclusive with position.

position.description: Zero-based filter slot. Mutually exclusive with name.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

tools.name: list_jobs

Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

tools.name: change_filter
tools.description: Moves the filter wheel to a filter, given either by name (case-insensitive, as listed in get_status) or by zero-based position; pass exactly one of them. NINA applies the profile's focus offsets for the filter. Runs as a background job holding the filter wheel; refused while a camera job runs.

name.description: Filter name, e.g. "Ha". Mutually exclusive with position.

position.description: Zero-based filter slot. Mutually exclusive with name.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

Returns { job: { id, kind, description, resource, state (running | succeeded | failed | cancelled | abandoned), cancelRequested, startedAt, finishedAt, outcome: { success, message, data } } }. wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish before returning (0-55, default 0 = return immediately).

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move, filter change or mount job (slew, park, home) runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: run_autofocus
tools.description: Runs NINA's autofocus routine with the profile's autofocus settings on the current filter (change_filter first to focus on another filter): takes a series of exposures at several focuser positions, fits the HFR curve and moves to the best position. Needs a connected camera and focuser and stars in the field (the mount should track a star field). force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: stop_all

It does NOT park the mount, stop guiding, warm the camera or disconnect anything; an idle mount is left alone (note that aborting a slew stops tracking on some mount drivers). Safe to repeat. This tool is never refused: together with cancel_job it stays available in read-only mode, and it needs no force while a sequence runs. Afterwards check get_status.

tools.name: get_sequence

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

tools.name: stop_all
tools.description: Emergency stop. In this order: stops the advanced sequence (so it cannot start its next item), cancels every background job, aborts the running camera exposure, stops the mount if it is slewing and halts a focuser move started over MCP. Every step runs even if an earlier one fails; the result lists each step. It does NOT park the mount, stop guiding, warm the camera or disconnect anything; an idle mount is left alone (note that aborting a slew stops tracking on some mount drivers). Safe to repeat. Use it whenever the user says stop/abort or something looks wrong (unexpected movement, collision risk, clouds/rain). This tool is never refused: together with cancel_job it stays available in read-only mode, and it needs no force while a sequence runs. Afterwards check get_status.

Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: clear_targets
tools.description: Removes all targets from the advanced sequence's target area; the start and end areas (cooling, unpark, park, warm-up instructions) stay. Unsaved targets are lost. Refused while the sequence runs. Use it before building a fresh plan with add_target.

tools.name: stop_all
tools.description: Emergency stop. In this order: stops the advanced sequence (so it cannot start its next item), cancels every background job, aborts the running camera exposure, stops the mount if it is slewing and halts a focuser move started over MCP. Every step runs even if an earlier one fails; the result lists each step. It does NOT park the mount, stop guiding, warm the camera or disconnect anything; an idle mount is left alone (note that aborting a slew stops tracking on some mount drivers). Safe to repeat. Use it whenever the user says stop/abort or something looks wrong (unexpected movement, collision risk, clouds/rain). This tool is never refused: together with cancel_job it stays available in read-only mode, and it needs no force while a sequence runs. Afterwards check get_status.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

tools.name: stop_all
tools.description: Emergency stop. In this order: stops the advanced sequence (so it cannot start its next item), cancels every background job, aborts the running camera exposure, stops the mount if it is slewing and halts a focuser move started over MCP. Every step runs even if an earlier one fails; the result lists each step. It does NOT park the mount, stop guiding, warm the camera or disconnect anything; an idle mount is left alone (note that aborting a slew stops tracking on some mount drivers). Safe to repeat. Use it whenever the user says stop/abort or something looks wrong (unexpected movement, collision risk, clouds/rain). This tool is never refused: together with cancel_job it stays available in read-only mode, and it needs no force while a sequence runs. Afterwards check get_status.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

Switching power can cut off devices (camera, mount): confirm with the user first. Runs as a background job holding the switch device.

index.description: Zero-based switch index as listed in get_status.

value.description: New value within the switch's min..max (0/1 for on/off switches).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole observatory: every device slot (camera, mount, focuser, filter_wheel, guider, rotator, flat_device, dome, switch, weather, safety_monitor) with connected flag, device name and key readings (e.g. camera temperature in °C and cooler power, mount RA in hours / Dec in degrees (J2000; the mount's native epoch values are in raHoursMount/decDegreesMount), altitude, tracking, park state, focuser position in steps, current filter, guider state (e.g. Guiding, Looping, Calibrating, Stopped) and RMS in arcsec), whether the advanced sequence is running and which items run, and all running background jobs. Fast and side-effect free; it does not wait for hardware. Call it first in every session, before acting on hardware, and to monitor progress.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: All background jobs of this pins instance (from any MCP session): running jobs first, then finished jobs of the last hour, newest first, in the same shape as get_job. Use it to find a job id after losing track of it, or to see what currently holds the mount, camera, focuser or other device.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of one running background job; the hardware operation is stopped where possible (exposure aborted, slew stopped, focuser halted, autofocus aborted). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 10) for the job to end and returns it in the get_job shape, with stopErrors listing driver stop commands that failed. Cancelling a job that already finished is not an error. If the job is still running after the wait (its device does not respond), abandon: true releases its resource anyway; the device may still be busy, so check get_status afterwards. Available even in read-only mode and while a sequence runs. To stop everything at once use stop_all.

job_id.description: Id of the job to cancel, e.g. "job-7f3a2c".

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end after the cancel request (0-55, default 10).

abandon.description: If the job is still running after wait_seconds, end it as abandoned and release its resource although its operation has not stopped. Only for a job that does not react to cancellation.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.
